run_convnext_training: run a ConvNeXt model training on ImageNet with configurable batch size and epochs
run_dropout_scheduling: run training with early or late dropout scheduling using configurable cutoff epochs
run_finetune_model: run fine-tuning from a pretrained checkpoint with configurable model key and head init scale
run_distributed_training: run distributed multi-GPU training with gradient accumulation and automatic mixed precision
run_model_evaluation: run evaluation only mode on a trained model with distributed evaluation support
